title: house.json
description: Per-repo manifest for the house conventions package. A why is required for disabling a default-on module, a branchPolicy other than pr, each carve-out, and a maxCoLoadLines above the default (kind coload-ceiling, with an integer ceiling equal to the value). Enabling a default-off module is configuration, not deviation.

version.description: The plugin version this repo's vendored rules were rendered from. Bumped by /house-rules:sync, never by hand.

branchPolicy.description: direct requires a deviations entry with a why.

carveOuts.description: Glob list (shell case semantics; * crosses /). Every changed path must match one for a protected-branch commit to pass. Each entry requires a deviations row.

guard.description: Dated record that the installed plugin supplies this repo's branch guard (ADR 0009). Accepted by the checker's guard family as the reachable guard; never read by the hook itself as a stand-down signal.

ratchet.description: Per-file line ceilings, generated by render from live counts, auto-tightened on shrink, never hand-typed. CLAUDE.md is not eligible.
